Definition: Akko (from its situation on a bay)
BiblicalUsage: Once, in the list of the conquest's failures: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho. The place is covered in the Biblical Places collection — this study covers only how the name is used.
TheologicalSignificance: The word is a place name, and its lesson is the failure attached to it. I believe Judges keeps this list for a reason: the cities Israel did not take became the snares Israel could not escape, and a half-finished obedience is the seed of the whole book's trouble.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
